name: lucubra
description: Local-first study engine: indexes your course files and gives your AI assistant grounded study tools.
long_description: Lucubra runs entirely on your machine. It reads the study folder you choose, builds a local index, and exposes planning, search and practice tools to Claude over MCP. Nothing is uploaded by Lucubra itself.

workspace.title: Study folder
workspace.description: The folder Lucubra indexes and keeps its .lucubra state in.
